versos.grego: Ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐξελθὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῆς οἰκίας ἐκάθητο παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν·

controles.web: On that day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the seaside.
controles.kjv: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
controles.livre: Naquele dia, Jesus saiu de casa e se sentou junto ao mar.

versos.grego: καὶ συνήχθησαν πρὸς αὐτὸν ὄχλοι πολλοί, ὥστε αὐτὸν εἰς πλοῖον ἐμβάντα καθῆσθαι, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἐπὶ τὸν αἰγιαλὸν εἱστήκει.

controles.web: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.
controles.kjv: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
controles.livre: E ajuntaram-se perto dele tantas multidões, de maneira que ele entrou num barco e se sentou; e toda a multidão ficou na praia,

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς πολλὰ ἐν παραβολαῖς λέγων Ἰδοὺ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ σπείρων τοῦ σπείρειν.

controles.web: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.
controles.kjv: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
controles.livre: E ele lhes falou muitas coisas por parábolas. Ele disse: Eis que o semeador saiu a semear.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν τῷ σπείρειν αὐτὸν ἃ μὲν ἔπεσεν παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν, καὶ ἐλθόντα τὰ πετεινὰ κατέφαγεν αὐτά.

controles.web: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.
controles.kjv: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
controles.livre: E enquanto semeava, caiu parte das sementes junto ao caminho, e vieram as aves e a comeram.

versos.grego: ἄλλα δὲ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὰ πετρώδη ὅπου οὐκ εἶχεν γῆν πολλήν, καὶ εὐθέως ἐξανέτειλεν διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν βάθος γῆς,

controles.web: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.
controles.kjv: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
controles.livre: E outra parte caiu entre pedras, onde não havia muita terra, e logo nasceu, porque não tinha terra funda.

versos.grego: ἡλίου δὲ ἀνατείλαντος ἐκαυματίσθη καὶ διὰ τὸ μὴ ἔχειν ῥίζαν ἐξηράνθη.

controles.web: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.
controles.kjv: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
controles.livre: Mas quando o sol surgiu, queimou-se; e por não ter raiz, secou-se.

versos.grego: ἄλλα δὲ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὰς ἀκάνθας, καὶ ἀνέβησαν αἱ ἄκανθαι καὶ ἀπέπνιξαν αὐτά.

controles.web: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.
controles.kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
controles.livre: E outra parte caiu entre espinhos, e os espinhos cresceram e a sufocaram.

versos.grego: ἄλλα δὲ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τὴν καλὴν καὶ ἐδίδου καρπόν, ὃ μὲν ἑκατὸν ὃ δὲ ἑξήκοντα ὃ δὲ τριάκοντα.

controles.web: Others fell on good soil, and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.
controles.kjv: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
controles.livre: E outra parte caiu em boa terra, e rendeu fruto: um a cem, outro a sessenta, e outro a trinta.

versos.grego: ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκουέτω.

controles.web: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
controles.kjv: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
controles.livre: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça.

versos.grego: Καὶ προσελθόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Διὰ τί ἐν παραβολαῖς λαλεῖς αὐτοῖς;

controles.web: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
controles.kjv: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
controles.livre: Então os discípulos se aproximaram, e lhe perguntaram: Por que falas a eles por parábolas?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν ὅτι Ὑμῖν δέδοται γνῶναι τὰ μυστήρια τῆς βασιλείας τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἐκείνοις δὲ οὐ δέδοται.

controles.web: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
controles.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
controles.livre: E ele respondeu: Porque a vós é dado saber os mistérios do Reino dos céus, mas a eles não é dado.

versos.grego: ὅστις γὰρ ἔχει, δοθήσεται αὐτῷ καὶ περισσευθήσεται· ὅστις δὲ οὐκ ἔχει, καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.
controles.kjv: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
controles.livre: Pois a quem tem, lhe será dado, e terá em abundância; mas a quem não tem, até aquilo que tem lhe será tirado.

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο ἐν παραβολαῖς αὐτοῖς λαλῶ, ὅτι βλέποντες οὐ βλέπουσιν καὶ ἀκούοντες οὐκ ἀκούουσιν οὐδὲ συνίουσιν.

controles.web: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.
controles.kjv: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
controles.livre: Por isso falo a eles por parábolas; porque vendo, não veem; e ouvindo, não ouvem, nem entendem.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀναπληροῦται αὐτοῖς ἡ προφητεία Ἡσαΐου ἡ λέγουσα Ἀκοῇ ἀκούσετε καὶ οὐ μὴ συνῆτε, καὶ βλέποντες βλέψετε καὶ οὐ μὴ ἴδητε.

controles.web: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says,   ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive:
controles.kjv: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
controles.livre: Assim neles se cumpre a profecia de Isaías, que diz: De fato ouvireis, mas não entendereis; De fato vereis, mas não enxergareis.

versos.grego: ἐπαχύνθη γὰρ ἡ καρδία τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου, καὶ τοῖς ὠσὶν βαρέως ἤκουσαν, καὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν ἐκάμμυσαν· μή ποτε ἴδωσιν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς καὶ τοῖς ὠσὶν ἀκούσωσιν καὶ τῇ καρδίᾳ συνῶσιν καὶ ἐπιστρέψωσιν, καὶ ἰάσομαι αὐτούς.

controles.web: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and should turn again; and I would heal them.’
controles.kjv: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
controles.livre: Porque o coração deste povo está insensível; Com seus ouvidos dificilmente ouvem, e seus olhos fecharam; A fim de não haver que seus olhos vejam, seus ouvidos ouçam, Seus corações entendam, e se arrependam, E eu os cure.

versos.grego: ὑμῶν δὲ μακάριοι οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ὅτι βλέπουσιν, καὶ τὰ ὦτα ὑμῶν ὅτι ἀκούουσιν.

controles.web: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
controles.kjv: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
controles.livre: Mas benditos  são os vossos olhos, porque veem; e os vossos ouvidos, porque ouvem.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πολλοὶ προφῆται καὶ δίκαιοι ἐπεθύμησαν ἰδεῖν ἃ βλέπετε καὶ οὐκ εἶδαν, καὶ ἀκοῦσαι ἃ ἀκούετε καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν.

controles.web: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.
controles.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
controles.livre: Pois em verdade vos digo que muitos profetas e justos desejaram ver o que vós vedes, mas não viram; e desejaram ouvir o que vós ouvis, mas não ouviram.

versos.grego: Ὑμεῖς οὖν ἀκούσατε τὴν παραβολὴν τοῦ σπείραντος.

controles.web: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.
controles.kjv: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
controles.livre: Portanto, ouvi vós a parábola do semeador:

versos.grego: Παντὸς ἀκούοντος τὸν λόγον τῆς βασιλείας καὶ μὴ συνιέντος, ἔρχεται ὁ πονηρὸς καὶ ἁρπάζει τὸ ἐσπαρμένον ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ· οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ παρὰ τὴν ὁδὸν σπαρείς.

controles.web: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom, and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes, and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.
controles.kjv: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
controles.livre: Quando alguém ouve a palavra do Reino e não a entende, o maligno vem e arranca o que foi semeado em seu coração; este é o que foi semeado junto ao caminho.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἐπὶ τὰ πετρώδη σπαρείς, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ τὸν λόγον ἀκούων καὶ εὐθὺς μετὰ χαρᾶς λαμβάνων αὐτόν·

controles.web: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;
controles.kjv: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
controles.livre: E o que foi semeado entre as pedras é o que ouve a palavra, e logo a recebe com alegria,

versos.grego: οὐκ ἔχει δὲ ῥίζαν ἐν ἑαυτῷ ἀλλὰ πρόσκαιρός ἐστιν, γενομένης δὲ θλίψεως ἢ διωγμοῦ διὰ τὸν λόγον εὐθὺς σκανδαλίζεται.

controles.web: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.
controles.kjv: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
controles.livre: mas não tem raiz em si mesmo. Em vez disso, dura um pouco, mas quando vem a aflição ou a perseguição pela palavra, logo se tornam infiéis.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἰς τὰς ἀκάνθας σπαρείς, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ τὸν λόγον ἀκούων, καὶ ἡ μέριμνα τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἡ ἀπάτη τοῦ πλούτου συμπνίγει τὸν λόγον, καὶ ἄκαρπος γίνεται.

controles.web: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
controles.kjv: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
controles.livre: E o que foi semeado entre os espinhos é o que ouve a palavra, mas a ansiedade com o tempo presente e a sedução das riquezas sufocam a palavra, e fica sem dar fruto.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἐπὶ τὴν καλὴν γῆν σπαρείς, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ τὸν λόγον ἀκούων καὶ συνιείς, ὃς δὴ καρποφορεῖ καὶ ποιεῖ ὃ μὲν ἑκατὸν ὃ δὲ ἑξήκοντα ὃ δὲ τριάκοντα.

controles.web: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word, and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit, and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”
controles.kjv: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
controles.livre: Mas o que foi semeado em boa terra, este é o que ouve e entende a palavra, e o que dá e produz fruto, um a cem, outro a sessenta, e outro a trinta.

versos.grego: Ἄλλην παραβολὴν παρέθηκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων Ὡμοιώθη ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἀνθρώπῳ σπείραντι καλὸν σπέρμα ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
controles.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
controles.livre: E ele lhes declarou outra parábola, dizendo: O Reino dos céus é semelhante a um homem que semeia boa semente em seu campo,

versos.grego: ἐν δὲ τῷ καθεύδειν τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἦλθεν αὐτοῦ ὁ ἐχθρὸς καὶ ἐπέσπειρεν ζιζάνια ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σίτου καὶ ἀπῆλθεν.

controles.web: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.
controles.kjv: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
controles.livre: Mas, enquanto as pessoas dormiam, o inimigo dele veio, semeou joio entre o trigo, e foi embora.

versos.grego: ὅτε δὲ ἐβλάστησεν ὁ χόρτος καὶ καρπὸν ἐποίησεν, τότε ἐφάνη καὶ τὰ ζιζάνια.

controles.web: But when the blade sprang up and produced fruit, then the darnel weeds appeared also.
controles.kjv: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
controles.livre: E, quando a erva cresceu e produziu fruto, então apareceu também o joio.

versos.grego: προσελθόντες δὲ οἱ δοῦλοι τοῦ οἰκοδεσπότου εἶπον αὐτῷ Κύριε, οὐχὶ καλὸν σπέρμα ἔσπειρας ἐν τῷ σῷ ἀγρῷ; πόθεν οὖν ἔχει ζιζάνια;

controles.web: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did this darnel come from?’
controles.kjv: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
controles.livre: Então os servos do dono da propriedade chegaram, e lhe perguntaram: “Senhor, não semeaste boa semente no teu campo? De onde, pois, veio o joio?”

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἔφη αὐτοῖς Ἐχθρὸς ἄνθρωπος τοῦτο ἐποίησεν. οἱ δὲ δοῦλοι αὐτῷ λέγουσιν Θέλεις οὖν ἀπελθόντες συλλέξωμεν αὐτά;

controles.web: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’   “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’
controles.kjv: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
controles.livre: E ele lhes respondeu: “Um inimigo fez isto”. Em seguida, os servos lhe perguntaram: “Queres, pois, que vamos e o tiremos?”

versos.grego: ὁ δέ φησιν Οὔ, μή ποτε συλλέγοντες τὰ ζιζάνια ἐκριζώσητε ἅμα αὐτοῖς τὸν σῖτον·

controles.web: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.
controles.kjv: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
controles.livre: Ele, porém, lhes respondeu: “Não, para não haver que, enquanto tirais o joio, arranqueis com ele também o trigo.

versos.grego: ἄφετε συναυξάνεσθαι ἀμφότερα ἕως τοῦ θερισμοῦ· καὶ ἐν καιρῷ τοῦ θερισμοῦ ἐρῶ τοῖς θερισταῖς Συλλέξατε πρῶτον τὰ ζιζάνια καὶ δήσατε αὐτὰ εἰς δέσμας πρὸς τὸ κατακαῦσαι αὐτά, τὸν δὲ σῖτον συναγάγετε εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην μου.

controles.web: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”
controles.kjv: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
controles.livre: Deixai-os crescer ambos juntos até a colheita; e no tempo da colheita direi aos que colhem: ‘Recolhei primeiro o joio, e amarrai-o em molhos, para o queimarem; mas ao trigo ajuntai no meu celeiro’.”

versos.grego: Ἄλλην παραβολὴν παρέθηκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων Ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν κόκκῳ σινάπεως, ὃν λαβὼν ἄνθρωπος ἔσπειρεν ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field;
controles.kjv: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
controles.livre: Ele lhes propôs outra parábola: O Reino dos céus é semelhante a um grão de mostarda que alguém tomou e semeou no seu campo.

versos.grego: ὃ μικρότερον μέν ἐστιν πάντων τῶν σπερμάτων, ὅταν δὲ αὐξηθῇ, μεῖζον τῶν λαχάνων ἐστὶν καὶ γίνεται δένδρον, ὥστε ἐλθεῖν τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ κατασκηνοῖν ἐν τοῖς κλάδοις αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”
controles.kjv: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
controles.livre: De fato, dentre todas as sementes, esta é a menor. Mas quando cresce, é a maior das hortaliças; e se torna tamanha árvore, que as aves do céu vêm e se aninham em seus ramos.

versos.grego: Ἄλλην παραβολὴν ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς Ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ζύμῃ, ἣν λαβοῦσα γυνὴ ἐνέκρυψεν εἰς ἀλεύρου σάτα τρία, ἕως οὗ ἐζυμώθη ὅλον.

controles.web: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measuresof meal, until it was all leavened.”
controles.kjv: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
controles.livre: Ele lhes disse outra parábola: O Reino dos céus é semelhante ao fermento que uma mulher tomou e misturou em três medidas de farinha,  ) até que tudo ficasse fermentado.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα πάντα ἐλάλησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν παραβολαῖς τοῖς ὄχλοις, καὶ χωρὶς παραβολῆς οὐδὲν ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς·

controles.web: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,
controles.kjv: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
controles.livre: Tudo isto Jesus falou por parábolas às multidões. Sem parábolas ele não lhes falava,

versos.grego: ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος Ἀνοίξω ἐν παραβολαῖς τὸ στόμα μου, ἐρεύξομαι κεκρυμμένα ἀπὸ καταβολῆς.

controles.web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,  “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”
controles.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
controles.livre: para que se cumprisse o que foi falado pelo profeta, que disse: Abrirei a minha boca em parábolas; Pronunciarei coisas escondidas desde a fundação.

versos.grego: Τότε ἀφεὶς τοὺς ὄχλους ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν. Καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ λέγοντες Διασάφησον ἡμῖν τὴν παραβολὴν τῶν ζιζανίων τοῦ ἀγροῦ.

controles.web: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
controles.kjv: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
controles.livre: Então Jesus despediu as multidões, e foi para casa. Seus discípulos se aproximaram dele, e disseram: Explica-nos a parábola do joio do campo.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Ὁ σπείρων τὸ καλὸν σπέρμα ἐστὶν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου·

controles.web: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,
controles.kjv: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
controles.livre: E ele respondeu: O que semeia a boa semente é o Filho do homem.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀγρός ἐστιν ὁ κόσμος· τὸ δὲ καλὸν σπέρμα, οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ υἱοὶ τῆς βασιλείας· τὰ δὲ ζιζάνιά εἰσιν οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ πονηροῦ,

controles.web: the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the children of the Kingdom; and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.
controles.kjv: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
controles.livre: E o campo é o mundo; e a boa semente, estes são os filhos do Reino; e o joio são os filhos do maligno.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἐχθρὸς ὁ σπείρας αὐτά ἐστιν ὁ διάβολος· ὁ δὲ θερισμὸς συντέλεια αἰῶνός ἐστιν, οἱ δὲ θερισταὶ ἄγγελοί εἰσιν.

controles.web: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.
controles.kjv: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
controles.livre: E o inimigo, que o semeou, é o diabo; e a colheita é o fim da era;  e os que colhem são os anjos.

versos.grego: ὥσπερ οὖν συλλέγεται τὰ ζιζάνια καὶ πυρὶ κατακαίεται, οὕτως ἔσται ἐν τῇ συντελείᾳ τοῦ αἰῶνος.

controles.web: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.
controles.kjv: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
controles.livre: Portanto, como o joio é colhido e queimado no fogo, assim também será no fim da era.

versos.grego: ἀποστελεῖ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ, καὶ συλλέξουσιν ἐκ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ πάντα τὰ σκάνδαλα καὶ τοὺς ποιοῦντας τὴν ἀνομίαν,

controles.web: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and those who do iniquity,
controles.kjv: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
controles.livre: O Filho do homem enviará seus anjos, e eles recolherão do seu Reino todas as causas do pecado,  assim como os que praticam injustiça,

versos.grego: καὶ βαλοῦσιν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν κάμινον τοῦ πυρός· ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.

controles.web: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
controles.kjv: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
controles.livre: e os lançarão na fornalha de fogo. Ali haverá choro e ranger de dentes.

versos.grego: τότε οἱ δίκαιοι ἐκλάμψουσιν ὡς ὁ ἥλιος ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Πατρὸς αὐτῶν. ὁ ἔχων ὦτα ἀκουέτω.

controles.web: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
controles.kjv: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
controles.livre: Então os justos brilharão como o sol, no Reino de seu Pai. Quem tem ouvidos, ouça.

versos.grego: Ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν θησαυρῷ κεκρυμμένῳ ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ, ὃν εὑρὼν ἄνθρωπος ἔκρυψεν, καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς χαρᾶς αὐτοῦ ὑπάγει καὶ πωλεῖ ὅσα ἔχει καὶ ἀγοράζει τὸν ἀγρὸν ἐκεῖνον.

controles.web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a treasure hidden in the field, which a man found, and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.
controles.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
controles.livre: O Reino dos céus é semelhante a um tesouro escondido num campo, que um homem, depois de achá-lo, escondeu. Então, em sua alegria, vai, vende tudo quanto tem, e compra aquele campo.

versos.grego: Πάλιν ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ἐμπόρῳ ζητοῦντι καλοὺς μαργαρίτας·

controles.web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,
controles.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
controles.livre: O Reino dos céus também é semelhante a um homem negociante, que buscava boas pérolas.

versos.grego: εὑρὼν δὲ ἕνα πολύτιμον μαργαρίτην ἀπελθὼν πέπρακεν πάντα ὅσα εἶχεν καὶ ἠγόρασεν αὐτόν.

controles.web: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
controles.kjv: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
controles.livre: Quando este achou uma pérola de grande valor, foi, vendeu tudo quanto tinha, e a comprou.

versos.grego: Πάλιν ὁμοία ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν σαγήνῃ βληθείσῃ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ ἐκ παντὸς γένους συναγαγούσῃ·

controles.web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet, that was cast into the sea, and gathered some fish of every kind,
controles.kjv: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
controles.livre: O Reino dos céus também é semelhante a uma rede lançada ao mar, que colhe toda espécie de peixes .

versos.grego: ἣν ὅτε ἐπληρώθη ἀναβιβάσαντες ἐπὶ τὸν αἰγιαλὸν καὶ καθίσαντες συνέλεξαν τὰ καλὰ εἰς ἄγγη, τὰ δὲ σαπρὰ ἔξω ἔβαλον.

controles.web: which, when it was filled, they drew up on the beach. They sat down, and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.
controles.kjv: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
controles.livre: E quando está cheia, os pescadores puxam-na à praia, sentam-se, e recolhem os bons em cestos, mas os ruins lançam fora.

versos.grego: οὕτως ἔσται ἐν τῇ συντελείᾳ τοῦ αἰῶνος· ἐξελεύσονται οἱ ἄγγελοι καὶ ἀφοριοῦσιν τοὺς πονηροὺς ἐκ μέσου τῶν δικαίων,

controles.web: So will it be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
controles.kjv: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
controles.livre: Assim será ao fim da era; os anjos sairão, e separarão dentre os justos os maus,

versos.grego: καὶ βαλοῦσιν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν κάμινον τοῦ πυρός· ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.

controles.web: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.”
controles.kjv: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
controles.livre: e os lançarão na fornalha de fogo. Ali haverá choro e ranger de dentes.

versos.grego: Συνήκατε ταῦτα πάντα; λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Ναί.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?”    They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
controles.livre: Entendestes todas estas coisas?Eles lhe responderam: Sim.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Διὰ τοῦτο πᾶς γραμματεὺς μαθητευθεὶς τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν ὅμοιός ἐστιν ἀνθρώπῳ οἰκοδεσπότῃ ὅστις ἐκβάλλει ἐκ τοῦ θησαυροῦ αὐτοῦ καινὰ καὶ παλαιά.

controles.web: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”
controles.kjv: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Portanto todo escriba que se tornou discípulo no Reino dos céus é semelhante a um chefe de casa, que do seu tesouro tira coisas novas e velhas.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὰς παραβολὰς ταύτας, μετῆρεν ἐκεῖθεν.

controles.web: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando Jesus acabou essas parábolas, retirou-se dali.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλθὼν εἰς τὴν πατρίδα αὐτοῦ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ αὐτῶν, ὥστε ἐκπλήσσεσθαι αὐτοὺς καὶ λέγειν Πόθεν τούτῳ ἡ σοφία αὕτη καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις;

controles.web: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom, and these mighty works?
controles.kjv: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
controles.livre: E vindo à sua terra, ensinava-os na sinagoga deles, de tal maneira que ficavam admirados, e diziam: De onde vêm a este tal sabedoria, e os milagres?

versos.grego: οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ τοῦ τέκτονος υἱός; οὐχ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ λέγεται Μαριὰμ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἰωσὴφ καὶ Σίμων καὶ Ἰούδας;

controles.web: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers, James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
controles.kjv: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
controles.livre: Não é este o filho do carpinteiro? E não se chama sua mãe Maria, e seus irmãos Tiago, José, Simão, e Judas?

versos.grego: καὶ αἱ ἀδελφαὶ αὐτοῦ οὐχὶ πᾶσαι πρὸς ἡμᾶς εἰσιν; πόθεν οὖν τούτῳ ταῦτα πάντα;

controles.web: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”
controles.kjv: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
controles.livre: Não estão todas as suas irmãs conosco? Ora, de onde vem a este tudo isto?

versos.grego: καὶ ἐσκανδαλίζοντο ἐν αὐτῷ. ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐκ ἔστιν προφήτης ἄτιμος εἰ μὴ ἐν τῇ πατρίδι καὶ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: They were offended by him.   But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and in his own house.”
controles.kjv: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
controles.livre: E se ofenderam  por causa dele. Mas Jesus lhes disse: Não há profeta sem honra, a não ser em sua terra, e em sua casa.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἐποίησεν ἐκεῖ δυνάμεις πολλὰς διὰ τὴν ἀπιστίαν αὐτῶν.

controles.web: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
controles.kjv: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
controles.livre: E não fez ali muitos milagres por causa da incredulidade deles.
